title: Release
description:
Contract `sites/release.v1`: one immutable release of a site, as the delivery route
`/v1/sites/{site}/content/release` serves it.

The release id is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 form of this document (workspace
design D4), so the document does not hold its own id. Every list is sorted and holds each item
once, so one content gives one id. The document names pages by slug and assets by SHA-256, never
by vault path, and every other member is refused.

`Deserialize` is hand-written because the order rules span a list and a navigation entry must
name a page of the release. It parses a private mirror struct and then calls
[`Release::validate`].

assets.description: Every asset that a page of the release uses, in ascending order of SHA-256, each once.

navigation.description: The navigation tree of the site, in the order the site shows it.

pages.description: Every page of the release, in ascending order of slug, each slug once.

publication_ids.description: The publications whose pages the release holds, in ascending order, each once.

site_id.description: The site that the release belongs to.

DigestHex.description: Lowercase hexadecimal bytes of a content digest.

MediaType.title: MediaType
MediaType.description: Internet media type of stored bytes, without parameters.

NavigationEntry.description: One entry of the navigation tree of a [`Release`].

children.description: The entries under this one, in the order the site shows them.

slug.description:
The page that the entry opens, which is a page of the release. Absent for an entry that
only groups its children.

title.description: The text that the site shows for the entry.

PageTitle.title: PageTitle
PageTitle.description:
The title of a page or of a navigation entry, as the release shows it.

1 to 255 characters with no C0 or DEL control character. The pattern carries the
255-character bound; the length guard is 1020 UTF-8 bytes, the most 255 characters can
take.

PublicationId.title: PublicationId
PublicationId.description:
The id of one publication of a site: 3 to 40 lower-case ASCII letters, digits and `-`.

The owner chooses the id and writes it in the manifest and in the path of
`PUT /v1/sites/{site}/publications/{publication}`.

media_type.description: The media type that the delivery route serves the bytes with.

sha256.description: The lowercase hex SHA-256 of the asset bytes; the asset URL is `assets/<sha256>`.

size_bytes.description:
The length of the asset bytes, at most 2^53 - 1, the largest integer that a JavaScript
number holds exactly.

page_sha256.description:
The lowercase hex SHA-256 of the `sites/page.v1` bytes that the delivery route serves for
this slug.

SiteId.title: SiteId
SiteId.description:
The id of one site: 3 to 40 lower-case ASCII letters, digits and `-`.

The grammar is the `site:<site id>` form of `WriteOrigin` in `ratatoskr-notes-contracts`.
The owner chooses the id, and it appears in every route under `/v1/sites/{site}/`.

Slug.title: Slug
Slug.description:
The slug of one page: unique in its release, and the last part of
`/v1/sites/{site}/content/pages/{slug}`.

Segments of lower-case ASCII letters, digits and `-`, separated by `/`, at most 1024
characters. The release builder takes the frontmatter key `slug`, or else the vault path
without `.md`, lower-cased, with each run of other characters than ASCII letters, digits
and `/` replaced by one `-` (workspace spec `site-publications`).
